 Predicted Stat Line: Buccaneers WR Chris Godwin vs Chicago
 Originally posted on
 Bucs Report 
  | 
 By JR Garner
  | 
 Last updated Nov 8, 2026 7:56 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 The Tampa Bay Buccaneers travel to Chicago for a Sunday Night Football matchup against the Bears. Chris Godwin will look to become a bigger part of the passing attack after Tampa Bay’s recent reliance on its running game.
 Godwin leads Tampa Bay with 243 receiving yards through eight games. With Emeka Egbuka questionable because of a foot injury, Godwin could have an opportunity to handle additional targets against Chicago.
 Predicted Stat Line for Chris Godwin vs Chicago 
 Targets: 7–10
 Receptions: 5–7
 Receiving Yards: 55–85
 Receiving Touchdowns: 0–1
 Rushing Attempts: 0–1
 Rushing Yards: 0–5
 Total Yards from Scrimmage: 55–90
 Fumbles: 0
 Key Factors Influencing 
 Chicago presents an interesting matchup for Tampa Bay’s passing attack. The Bears have allowed opposing receivers opportunities underneath, which could benefit Godwin’s ability to work across the middle.
 Godwin has recorded 27 receptions for 243 yards through eight games. While his production has been limited, Tampa Bay’s recent offensive approach has placed considerably more emphasis on running the football.
 The Buccaneers attempted only three passes against Atlanta in their Week 8 shutout. That unusual performance makes projecting the passing workload difficult, but Baker Mayfield should have more opportunities against Chicago.
 Emeka Egbuka’s availability could also influence Godwin’s target share. Egbuka is questionable after missing time with a foot injury. If he cannot play or is limited, Godwin could become Mayfield’s primary receiving option.
 Godwin’s experience and ability to create separation underneath should provide Mayfield with a reliable option. Chicago’s defense will need to account for Tampa Bay’s rushing attack, potentially creating opportunities through play-action.
 The Buccaneers will also need to find a better balance offensively against a 6-2 Chicago team. Godwin’s ability to move the chains could become important if Tampa Bay falls behind and needs to throw more frequently.
 Final Stat Predictions 
 Targets: 8
 Receptions: 6
 Receiving Yards: 72
 Receiving Touchdowns: 0
 Rushing Attempts: 0
 Rushing Yards: 0
 Total Yards from Scrimmage: 72
 Fumbles: 0
 Godwin should see a noticeable increase in involvement compared to Tampa Bay’s previous outing. His experience and reliability make him an important option for Mayfield against Chicago.
 Egbuka’s questionable status could create additional opportunities for Godwin. My prediction has the veteran receiver leading Tampa Bay in receptions while moving the chains throughout the evening.
 Final Prediction: 8 targets, 6 receptions, 72 receiving yards, 0 receiving touchdowns, 0 rushing attempts, 72 total yards, 0 fumbles.
